messages:
marta: Quick preflight for tonight's APAC embeddings smoke test — beta-customer is running a short burst (~6k queries over ~15m). I'll be on call until 03:30 UTC and will hand off at 03:25. Preflight steps I did: prewarmed pool 'embeddings-hot', bumped burst_limit to 12%, and pushed a temporary routing rule to prefer nova-2 for small requests. :white_check_mark:

ravi: copy. can you drop the dashboard + queue check command? :eyes:

marta: dashboard: https://console.internal/redwood/pools/embeddings-hot (internal)
queue check:
```
curl -s "https://internal.api/pools/embeddings-hot/metrics" | jq '.queue_length, .utilization_percent'
```
run that if latency creeps up. logs for the test are under the run id `beta-embed-2026-03-17` in cloud-logs.

oncall-bot: [metric] embeddings-hot util=63% burst_limit=12% queue=18 -> no alert (threshold 80%)

oncall-bot: [info] nova-2 prewarm ok (3 instances), kvcache hit_ratio=0.87

alex: thx. watching kvcache — if hit_ratio drops <0.6 we should force prefix-cache flush and scale background worker. I'll be reachable until 04:00.

marta: noted. Also FYI I disabled the new batching-experiment flag for this pool (was causing slight tail-latency on long tails). Re-enabled after test if stable.

samir: I can take the handoff at 03:25 UTC. If you see errors > 1% or 5xxs start climbing, ping me and i'll roll a quick fallback to model-variant v2.0. :thumbsup:

ravi: small ask — if you get time before handing off, can you post the quick repro commands for the failing request pattern we saw yesterday? want them in the runbook under "embeddings-hot -> triage".

marta: sure. adding short snippet to runbook now.
```
# repro for slow tail
python tools/repro_embeds.py --model model-embed-v2 --input tests/long-docs.json --batch-size 1
```
should paste in runbook in ~2min.

oncall-bot: [reminder] scheduled maintenance in eu-west-1 at 05:00 UTC — not expected to affect embeddings-hot (region nova-2 is ap-southeast), but keep an eye on cross-region fallback logs.

samir: thanks, taking over at 03:25. i'll monitor queue and util, and log any handoff notes in the shift doc.

marta: handing off now -> samir. if anything odd, tag @samir and add `#embeds-handback` to the message. leaving slack but on pager for 20m. :wave:

samir: on it. good handoff, thanks! :raised_hands:

alex: quick ping — code review for the batching config change is in my queue (PR 587). samir/ravi if you notice anything odd while i'm out, comment there and i'll take a look after 04:15.

ravi: will do. good luck.

marta: thanks all, see ya.
